thread:
Harper Lin: Quick follow-up from tonight's incident (02:45 UTC). Tail latency rose with throughput coupling once serialized-batch-bytes exceeded ~2.5MB. Looks infra + batching related. Proposing a short SLO plan + owners.

Dmitri Volkov: Can you share the pattern and numbers?

Harper Lin: Baseline throughput ~900rps, spike to 1400rps; p99 went 180ms->720ms for ~8m. Error-budget impact: ~2.2% extra burn on p99 budget for the day. Dashboard snippets: https://redwood/dashboards/latency/serialized-batch (perm view).

Zoe Martinez: Instead of item-count caps, can we cap serialized-batch-bytes (2MB->1MB) and add a gradual backoff? That should reduce write amplification. Ops/SLO implications?

Tasha (ops): Ops preference: temporary progressive SLO ladder + batch-bytes cap. We'll record in SLA change log and auto-revert.

Harper Lin: Draft actions: 1) Temp SLO ladder: p99 target -> 450ms for 48h, if repeated within 7d escalate to 600ms (owner Tasha, immediate, auto-revert rules) 2) Ingress control: cap serialized-batch-bytes 2MB->1MB + exponential backoff (owner Dmitri, 24h, canary) 3) Driver fix: coalesce small writes and align fsyncs (owner Dmitri, 5d) 4) Observability: add serialized-bytes histogram + p99-by-bytes tile and probe (owner Zoe, 48h) 5) Runbook: add auto-fallback to best-effort model routing for non-critical traffic when p99>0.5 (owner Harper, 7d) 6) Governance: any SLO ladder step taken requires a 7d postmortem link (owner Tasha).

slo-bot: Suggested change note: "temp: p99 ladder to 450ms for 48h - INF-5032 (auto-revert configured)"

Dmitri Volkov: I'll open PR for batch-bytes cap and backoff with canary rollout (10%->50%->100%). ETA 18h, will include perf numbers. Opening INF-5033 for driver tasks (ETA 5d).

Zoe Martinez: I'll add the probe and dashboard tile. Proposed PromQL for serialized-bytes histogram: 
```
sum(rate(serialized_batch_size_bytes_bucket[5m])) by (le)
```
Alert: warn at sustained p99>350ms for 5m, page at 450ms for 10m.

Tasha (ops): I'll apply the SLO ladder now (INF-5032) and add SLA note. Auto-revert is set. Also adding a policy to require customer-facing notification only if concession >24h.

incident-bot: Created ticket INF-5032 "p99: SLO ladder + serialized-batch mitigation" and INF-5033 "driver: write-coalescer" and linked this thread.

Harper Lin: Recurrence check: found 3 similar micro-spikes in last 90d tied to large serialized batches. I'll open INF-5034 recurrence-watch that triggers automated cap if >=2 events/30d. Owner Harper, ETA 7d.

Dmitri Volkov: PR and INF tickets incoming.

Zoe Martinez: Will post dashboard update when probe is live.

Harper Lin: Recap owners: Dmitri (ingest caps + driver INF-5033), Zoe (observability + probe), Tasha (SLO ladder + governance), Harper (runbook + recurrence INF-5034). 15m sync tomorrow to confirm PRs/tickets/announcements. Close after PRs referenced.

Dmitri Volkov: :thumbsup:

Tasha (ops): Posting SLA note and will announce in #announcements after PR links are present.

Harper Lin: Leaving thread open for updates; will close when INF-5032/5033/5034 and PRs are linked.
